title: Scandal, Social Movement, and Change: Evidence from #MeToo in Hollywood
eligible_reason: Single common shock (post_weinstein = sale after October 2017) interacted with a time-invariant producer-team association with Harvey Weinstein. The unit is the script sale (repeated cross-section of 4,188 projects), with quarter and studio-cluster structure and project-level controls in most columns. No staggered adoption. Data not shipped.
design_notes: analysis codes.do: reg has_women post_weinsteinXWassociation Wassociation i.quarter_cal, cluster(gAllStudio) (column 1 without project controls), then with team and project controls, intensity bins, CEM weights, and subsample splits.

specs.notes: Excluded: single common date, repeated cross-section without unit FE.

data_access: proprietary (Done Deal Pro subscription database) plus IMDb
data_files_note: read me.docx: 'We cannot provide our data for public use because the Done Deal Database is proprietary.'
screener_notes: Screened from package only (no article text).
